subject: Post-demo: Procurement & vendor setup (PO vs card)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Linda Cho <linda.cho@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 16:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Procurement & vendor setup (PO vs card)

Hi Linda —

Great to meet you and the team on the demo today. Quick recap and suggested next steps on procurement so we can get you into a sandbox and plan a pilot deployment: 

1) Procurement readiness: Can you confirm whether your procurement process prefers issuing a PO (Net 30) or paying by corporate card for initial invoices? Many customers start with card for the POC and move to PO for production, but we’re flexible.

2) Vendor setup packet: I’ve attached our standard vendor packet (redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf) and our W-9 (W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf). If your procurement team has an intake form, please send it back filled and we’ll return the signed packet ASAP.

3) Marketplace vs direct: You mentioned potential interest in using the Acme Cloud Marketplace. If procurement prefers marketplace purchases, let us know — we can provide pricing and marketplace SKU/partner IDs. If you need us to be a direct vendor, we’ll proceed with vendor setup paperwork.

4) Banking / payment instructions: For PO/ACH payments we typically provide banking instructions after vendor onboarding. We do not publish raw bank details in initial emails; we can send them to a verified procurement contact or via DocuSign.

Next suggested actions:
- Linda / procurement: confirm PO vs card and share any vendor intake form (if you have one).
- We’ll return completed vendor packet and W-9, and confirm invoice terms (Net 30/60) and marketplace option.

I’ll follow up mid-week if I don’t hear back. Thanks again — excited to get Acme Cloud set up.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf (vendor packet, 3 pages)
Attachment: W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf (signed W-9)

From: Linda Cho <linda.cho@acmecloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Cloud Procurement <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Procurement & vendor setup (PO vs card)

Hi Marcus —

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the packet. A few notes from procurement at Acme: 

- Preferred commercial path: We generally prefer to issue a PO for any spend that will be ongoing. For an initial POC we can sometimes use a corporate card, but our preferred path is PO with Net 30 terms.
- Vendor paperwork: Our procurement team requires: completed vendor setup form (I’ve attached our standard form), a signed W-9, and vendor banking details for ACH. I’ve attached ACME_vendor_setup_form.pdf (filled by our intake team).
- Marketplace: We are open to marketplace purchases but that depends on the SKU and whether it matches the pilot scope — it can be faster for procurement, though there are sometimes differences in invoicing and discounts.

Couple of Qs: 
1) Do you accept PO via DocuSign or does Acme need to send a PDF PO to invoices@redwood.com?
2) Is Net 30 acceptable?
3) Can you provide a single point of contact on the finance side (for secure delivery of bank details)?

I’ve attached the ACME vendor form (ACME_vendor_setup_form_filled.pdf). Please advise next steps and turnaround time.

Best,
Linda Cho
Procurement Manager, Acme Cloud
linda.cho@acmecloud.com
Attachment: ACME_vendor_setup_form_filled.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Linda Cho <linda.cho@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 10:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Procurement & vendor setup (PO vs card)

Hi Linda —

Thanks for the details and the completed form — that’s super helpful. Quick answers: 

- We accept PO via PDF emailed to invoices@redwood.com; we can also accept signed PO via DocuSign if that’s how your team prefers to route approvals.
- Net 30 is fine.
- I’ll put our finance contact (and secure delivery method) below — we'll avoid sending bank info over generic email and instead share via DocuSign or our finance portal.

Finance contact: Elena Voss (Finance Operations) — elena.voss@redwood.com (I am CCing internally to loop Elena in next).

Next steps I’ll take now: 
- Send completed vendor packet and our signed W-9 to procurement (attached here).
- Confirm with Elena the secure channel to share ACH instructions — if you prefer DocuSign or a secure upload to your vendor portal, we’ll do that.

I’ve attached: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf (completed & initialed), W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf (signed). We’ll wait on your confirmation for where to deliver banking details. 

Would you be available for a 15-min call tomorrow to align on the paperwork handoff? If so, I can send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Marcus
Attachment: redwood_vendor_packet_v1.pdf
Attachment: W-9_Redwood_Inference.pdf

Thanks Marcus — we received the packet and W-9. I have a couple follow-ups after reviewing: 

- Please confirm if Redwood requires a signed master services agreement (MSA) before first invoice or if the PO + vendor packet is sufficient for your billing team. If you require an MSA, please share the latest MSA for our legal team to review.
- We prefer DocuSign for PO acceptance. If you can accept DocuSign POs please confirm the signing email address.

Also attaching the filled vendor form we received (ACME_vendor_setup_form_filled.pdf) — it looks complete. If you can get bank details to us via DocuSign, we can proceed to set you up in our vendor portal and issue a PO once legal confirms the MSA (if required).

Thanks,
ACME Procurement Team
procurement@acmecloud.com

Appreciate the quick review. A few clarifications and proposed next steps (mutual action plan):

1) MSA: We typically sign a standard Redwood MSA for customers doing production deployments. For initial pilots we can proceed on PO + vendor packet and then execute the MSA during pilot to avoid blocking the POC. I’ve linked the current MSA here for your legal review: https://redwood.example.com/legal/MSA_Redwood_Inference_v3.pdf

2) DocuSign: We accept DocuSign POs. Please have the PO sent or signed to invoices@redwood.com or DocuSign envelope to elena.voss@redwood.com. 

3) Bank details: Elena (cc'd) will send ACH instructions via DocuSign once you confirm the preferred DocuSign email/recipient.

Proposed immediate next steps: 
- Acme procurement: confirm DocuSign email recipient for bank details and confirm whether legal will require an MSA before PO issuance.
- Redwood (Marcus/Marissa): set up a 30-min handoff with Elena for finance and with Dev for any technical questions needed for SOW.
- Schedule a 15-min sync next Tue (time options provided in calendar invite).
